we identified a consensus sequence recognized and cleaved specifically by IRE1a.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IRE1α RNase domain has a unique substrate specificity and cleavage site preference, and that this specificity is determined by a consensus sequence in the substrate RNAs.
the cleavage of target RNAs by IRE1alpha is mediated by the recognition of a consensus sequence, which is accompanied by a stem loop structure, in target RNAs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the IRE1α RNase activity is not only restricted to XBP1 mRNA, but rather is involved in the cleavage of multiple mRNAs in response to ER stress.
